hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; uv run --quiet ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; uv run --quiet ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(uv run --quiet pyrefly check "$f" 2>&1) || jq -nc --arg c "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $c}}'; exit 0
